header.title: A digital ecosystem, built deliberately.
header.lede: Chevrette isn't a mining app, an investment platform, or a gambling product. It's a long-term digital ecosystem — and this page explains exactly what that means.

what.title: A membership in something being built, not a promise of profit.
what.p1: Chevrette is a premium digital ecosystem centered on quality, innovation, simplicity and long-term growth. At its core today is an Android application where members register, verify their account, collect Daily Points, invite friends through a referral system, and follow the community's progress on a global leaderboard.
what.p2: Nothing about Chevrette is designed to look like a financial product. There is no trading, no yield, and no promise of returns. The application exists to give an early community a simple, well-made place to gather while the wider ecosystem is developed in public, stage by stage.

vision.title: Technology that respects the people using it.
vision.p1: We believe digital products can be premium without being loud — that restraint, clarity and craftsmanship are still a competitive advantage. The long-term vision for Chevrette is an ecosystem of digital services, membership benefits and community tools that feel considered rather than rushed to market.

mission.title: Build the foundation first. Everything else follows.
mission.p1: Our mission is to earn trust before we ask for anything else. That starts with a stable, secure application and an honest roadmap — no unrealistic promises, no shifting goalposts. Every future feature, from a premium store to new digital services, is built on top of a foundation that already works.

philosophy.title: Grayscale by design.
philosophy.p1: Chevrette is intentionally monochrome — in the application, and on this website. The absence of color is a decision, not a limitation: it removes noise, keeps attention on content, and lets typography and spacing carry the brand's personality. It's an approach borrowed from watchmaking and premium hardware more than it is from typical app design.

values.title: What guides every decision.
values.v1d: We'd rather ship something considered later than something rushed now.
values.v2d: Every feature has to earn its place. Complexity is a cost, not a feature.
values.v3d: The roadmap is public, described in stages, and updated honestly as things change.
values.v4d: Chevrette is built for years, not for a single announcement cycle.

future.title: What we're building toward.
future.note: The future ecosystem is directional, not guaranteed. It will evolve as the community and the foundation grow — see the Roadmap for how we sequence this work.

goal.title: A global ecosystem people are proud to belong to.
goal.p1: The long-term goal is simple to state and deliberately slow to achieve: turn an early community around a well-made Android application into a global, multi-service digital ecosystem — without ever compromising the quality and restraint Chevrette started with.

cta.title: See how we plan to get there.
cta.lede: The full, stage-by-stage roadmap is public.

header.title: Questions, answered plainly.
header.lede: If something isn't covered here, reach out on the Contact page.

faq.a1: Chevrette is a premium digital ecosystem built around quality, innovation, simplicity and long-term growth. Today it centers on an Android application where members collect Daily Points, invite friends and follow the community leaderboard.
faq.q2: Is Chevrette a mining, investment or gambling app?
faq.a2: No. Chevrette is not a mining application, an investment platform, a financial service or a gambling app. There is no trading, no yield and no promise of financial returns.
faq.a3: Once you're registered and verified, you can claim Daily Points every 24 hours from inside the app. A countdown shows exactly when your next claim is available.
faq.a4: Yes. The application is free to install and use.
faq.q5: Why is the application only available for Android?
faq.a5: We focused entirely on making the Android experience excellent before expanding anywhere else, and the app is now available on Google Play.
faq.q6: Is Chevrette available on Google Play?
faq.a6: Yes. Chevrette is available on Google Play — use the Google Play button on this website to install it on your Android device.
faq.a7: Points are Chevrette's core in-app metric, earned through Daily Points claims and referrals. They determine your position on the global leaderboard.
faq.a8: Yes. Every account has a personal referral code that can be shared with anyone.
faq.q9: How does the referral system work?
faq.a9: Share your referral code with a friend. When they register using it, you both receive a referral reward automatically — no extra steps required.
faq.q10: Do I need to verify my email?
faq.a10: Yes. Email verification is required to fully activate your account and keep the community secure.
faq.a11: Account security and email verification are built into Chevrette from the first release. See the Privacy Policy for full details on how information is handled.
faq.a12: Yes. Stage 2 through Stage 5 of the roadmap outline planned improvements and a wider ecosystem, including a premium store, membership benefits and new digital services.
faq.q13: What is the future vision for Chevrette?
faq.a13: A global digital ecosystem — expanding beyond the current application into a utility token, a premium store, digital products, membership benefits and community rewards, all built on the same foundation of quality and restraint.
faq.q14: How can I contact the team?
faq.a14: You can reach us by email, X (Twitter) or Telegram — all listed on the Contact page.
faq.q15: How do I get the app?
faq.a15: Use the Google Play button on this website, or search for Chevrette in the Google Play Store on your Android device.

privacy.s1p: This Privacy Policy explains how Chevrette ("we", "our", "the application") collects, uses and protects information when you use the Chevrette Android application and this website. Chevrette is not a financial, investment, mining or gambling service.
privacy.s2p: To provide the application's core features, we collect the information necessary for account creation and operation, including:
privacy.s2l1: Account details you provide, such as your name and email address
privacy.s2l2: Authentication data used to keep your account secure
privacy.s2l3: In-app activity relevant to the service, such as Daily Points claims, referral relationships and leaderboard standing
privacy.s2l4: Basic technical information such as device type and app version, used for stability and security
privacy.s2l5: Your cryptocurrency wallet address, if you choose to add one to your profile — used only to contact you regarding a potential future token distribution, should one be introduced. Providing a wallet address is optional and is never required to use the application.
privacy.s3p: Information is used to operate and secure your account, calculate Daily Points and referral rewards, maintain the global leaderboard, communicate important updates, and improve the reliability and security of the application over time.
privacy.s4p: Email verification is required to activate your account. Your email address is used for authentication, account recovery and important service communications — never sold to third parties.
privacy.s5p: We do not sell your personal information. Limited data may be shared with service providers strictly necessary to operate the application (such as secure infrastructure and authentication providers), under obligations to protect it.
privacy.s6p: Account information is retained for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us through the Contact page.
privacy.s7p: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details on the Contact page.
privacy.s8p: This Privacy Policy may be updated as the application and ecosystem evolve. Material changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.
privacy.s9p: Questions about this policy can be sent to the email address listed on the Contact page.

terms.s2p: Chevrette is a digital ecosystem application. It is not a mining application, an investment platform, a financial service or a gambling application. Daily Points and referral rewards are in-app engagement metrics only, with no cash value, redemption guarantee, or promise of financial return unless explicitly stated otherwise in a future update to these Terms.
terms.s3p: You must provide accurate information when registering and are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Email verification is required to activate full access to the application.
terms.s4p: You agree not to misuse the referral system (including through fake accounts or automated activity), attempt to compromise the security of the application, or use the service for any unlawful purpose.
terms.s5p: Chevrette is distributed as an Android application through Google Play. Availability may change as development continues.
terms.s6p: References on this website to a future utility token, premium store, digital products, membership tiers or other ecosystem features describe current development intentions, not commitments, guarantees or offers of any product, security or financial instrument.
terms.s7p: The Chevrette name, logo and application content are the property of Chevrette and may not be copied, reproduced or redistributed without permission.
terms.s8p: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, including misuse of the referral or Daily Points systems.
terms.s9p: The application and this website are provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
terms.s10p: These Terms may be updated as the application and ecosystem evolve. Continued use of the application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.s11p: Questions about these Terms can be sent to the email address listed on the Contact page.
